queries.query: large language model "network configuration" OR "intent-to-configuration" OR "intent to config"
queries.rationale: Locate work on LLMs translating human intent/natural language into concrete network configs (core phenomenon).

queries.query: LLM OR "large language model" "configuration repair" OR "config repair" OR "configuration correction" network
queries.rationale: Find studies on repair/patching of misgenerated network configurations by LLMs or hybrid systems (mechanisms & mitigations).
Search for explicit generate–validate–repair architectures and their instantiations in networking.

queries.query: tool-assisted LLM self-correction verifier "network" "Batfish" OR "cfg" OR "formal verification"
queries.rationale: Identify work combining LLMs with deterministic/verifier tools (e.g., Batfish, model checkers) for correctness guarantees.

queries.query: network configuration verification "Batfish" OR "Header space analysis" OR "HSA" OR "formal verification"
queries.rationale: Collect literature on deterministic validators and verification techniques that can be used as ground-truth validators for LLM outputs.

queries.query: LLM OR "large language model" "failure modes" "network" "misconfiguration" OR "incorrect config"
queries.rationale: Survey documented failure modes of LLMs specifically causing operational/networking errors (safety/reliability phenomenon).
Find methods to assess or bound LLM confidence/uncertainty for safe operational decision-making (mechanisms for mitigations).
Identify constrained-generation approaches (templates, schema-constrained outputs, policy filters) applicable to NetOps.
Collect existing benchmark efforts and datasets that evaluate LLMs or agents on networking/AIOps tasks to assess benchmark validity and gaps.

queries.query: "benchmark validity" OR "construct validity" OR "evaluation validity" LLM OR "language model" networking OR NetOps
queries.rationale: Locate methodological critiques and best-practices on whether current benchmarks measure operational correctness/safety (benchmark validity).

queries.query: "adversarial testing" OR "fuzzing" network configuration OR "config fuzzing" "LLM"
queries.rationale: Find adversarial and robustness testing methods for network configurations and how they could stress-test LLM-generated outputs.
Identify evaluation platforms (simulators/testbeds) used to execute and validate NetOps actions and how to emulate execution of LLM outputs.
Survey human-in-the-loop designs for safety—when operators approve or mediate LLM-suggested NetOps actions (mitigations & workflows).
Gather operational metrics and measurement methods relevant for quantifying correctness, safety, and reliability of NetOps actions.
Collect neighbouring work on agentic/autonomous agents applied to network management, orchestration, and decision-making.
Search for named systems/projects that most closely match the target topic (nearest-work identification).

inclusion_criteria: Works explicitly addressing LLMs/LLM-agents or generative models applied to NetOps/AIOps or network-configuration tasks
Empirical studies, tool papers, reproducible method descriptions, benchmarks, or evaluation-framework papers
Deterministic validators/verification tools and papers describing their use in configuration validation (e.g., Batfish, HSA)
Peer-reviewed conference/journal papers, accepted workshop papers, and preprints (arXiv) with verifiable metadata or public artifacts
Papers that provide methods, datasets, code, or clear experimental protocols enabling reproduction or adaptation
English-language sources; non-English only if a verified translation/metadata is available
exclusion_criteria: High-level opinion pieces, marketing materials, or blog posts without technical detail or reproducible evidence
Papers purely about general LLM/NLP advances without any NetOps/AIOps or configuration application context
Proprietary internal operator documents not publicly available
Non-verifiable claims (no authorship/venue/date or missing identifiers) or fabricated metadata
Work produced during the programme's pre-lock development runs unless independently verifiable and publicly available
date_rationale: Primary focus: 2019–2026 to capture rapid LLM/agent advances (GPT-era) and recent NetOps AIOps work; include earlier seminal verification and NetOps papers (pre-2019) for foundational methods (e.g., HSA, Batfish) where directly relevant. Search window cutoff: through current literature indexed up to 2026-08 to ensure freshness for the CNSM 2026 run.
